description: Twenty-four thin bars of screen time per hour, with a dashed line marking the hourly average.
overview: A screen-time card with 24 thin hourly bars, a total in the header and a dashed line at the hourly average. Use it for any day-at-a-glance metric with many small periods.
usage: Replace the 24 values in `chartData` with your own per-hour numbers; the total and the average line are computed from them. Change the axis `ticks` to label different hours, and update the minute unit in the axis, tooltip and header if you measure something else.
notes: With 24 narrow bars, the tooltip is the most reliable way to read a single hour. Focus the chart and use the arrow keys to step through the hours.
